requirements_summary: Workload: real-time reranking + short-response chat for product recs; median response len 24 tokens.
Target SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 90ms, p99 < 120ms for 32-token outputs at steady-state.
Throughput guarantee ask: minimum sustained 120k tokens/sec across 8x GPUs reserved (baseline), ability to scale to 300k tokens/sec with burst credits.
Concurrency caps: prefer soft cap at 500 concurrent sessions; hard limit negotiated with autoscale/fallback policy.
Burst policy: pre-purchased burst credits for +2x sustained throughput for 48h windows; automatic throttle above burst without hard failures.
Reserved GPU planning: 8x A100-equivalent capacity (or quantized alternatives) with quarterly review and option to add 2 GPUs for seasonal months.
Latency fallbacks: automatic routing to regional spare capacity or quantized model variant with degraded quality thresholds defined.
Billing: blended reserved rate + usage for bursts; request example invoice scenarios for 12-month and 24-month commits.
